title: Craft chickens with random things
description: This mods lets you craft chickens out of things that shouldn't be mixed with it, giving them effects or not depending on the material you chose to mix them with. Similar to apples mods
body:
This mods lets you craft chickens out of things that shouldn't be mixed with it. You can craft apples chicken, experience chicken etc. Some have effects, some custom effects, some don't do anything more than feeding you well... and maybe not. Just depends on the material you use. There enough chickens for the description not to tell what they all do, plus i keep updating my mods to add more.

Made the textures myself.
